meta.title: Hope
meta.description: The Oasis opens its doors to welcome its new guests.

units.rawText: Reception Counter, the Oasis.
units.displayText: Reception Counter, the Oasis.

spans.text: Reception Counter, the Oasis.

units.rawText: In... in any case... we'll start with your neural cloud evaluation, s-s-s-so please proceed to the Medical Department...
units.displayText: In... in any case... we'll start with your neural cloud evaluation, s-s-s-so please proceed to the Medical Department...

spans.text: In... in any case... we'll start with your neural cloud evaluation, s-s-s-so please proceed to the Medical Department...

units.rawText: You look very tense, ma'am. Do you not get Doll visitors very often?
units.displayText: You look very tense, ma'am. Do you not get Doll visitors very often?

spans.text: You look very tense, ma'am. Do you not get Doll visitors very often?

units.rawText: Er, I-I'm fine, I guess...? Uh, er... Never mind.
units.displayText: Er, I-I'm fine, I guess...? Uh, er... Never mind.

spans.text: Er, I-I'm fine, I guess...? Uh, er... Never mind.

units.rawText: (What should I do, he looks so scary, just looking at him is frightening... Help me, Imhotep...)
units.displayText: What should I do, he looks so scary, just looking at him is frightening... Help me, Imhotep...

spans.text: What should I do, he looks so scary, just looking at him is frightening... Help me, Imhotep...

units.rawText: ...Tell me about this place. I hear Evelyn's here too, isn't she?
units.displayText: ...Tell me about this place. I hear Evelyn's here too, isn't she?

spans.text: ...Tell me about this place. I hear Evelyn's here too, isn't she?

units.rawText: Ah, yes, yes she is! Evelyn's already here! No, I mean Evelyn's already joined the Oasis...
units.displayText: Ah, yes, yes she is! Evelyn's already here! No, I mean Evelyn's already joined the Oasis...

spans.text: Ah, yes, yes she is! Evelyn's already here! No, I mean Evelyn's already joined the Oasis...

units.rawText: Alright, I'll take it from here.
units.displayText: Alright, I'll take it from here.

spans.text: Alright, I'll take it from here.

units.rawText: Ah, okay, Professor!
units.displayText: Ah, okay, Professor!

spans.text: Ah, okay, Professor!

units.rawText: Bonee hurriedly flees the scene.
units.displayText: Bonee hurriedly flees the scene.

spans.text: Bonee hurriedly flees the scene.

units.rawText:
Greetings, Commander. Python reporting for duty.
...Or should I call you Professor?
units.displayText:
Greetings, Commander. Python reporting for duty.
...Or should I call you Professor?

spans.text:
Greetings, Commander. Python reporting for duty.
...Or should I call you Professor?

units.rawText: Call me whatever you're comfortable with, Instructor Python. I'm the one in charge of the Oasis, <cmdr>.
units.displayText: Call me whatever you're comfortable with, Instructor Python. I'm the one in charge of the Oasis, {교수}.

spans.text: Call me whatever you're comfortable with, Instructor Python. I'm the one in charge of the Oasis,

units.rawText: So you're administering the neural cloud evaluation yourself. What a surprise.
units.displayText: So you're administering the neural cloud evaluation yourself. What a surprise.

spans.text: So you're administering the neural cloud evaluation yourself. What a surprise.

options.rawText: I was forced to take a shift.
options.displayText: I was forced to take a shift.

spans.text: I was forced to take a shift.
I hope it pleases you.

units.rawText: Well, let's try to enjoy ourselves in the process, then.
units.displayText: Well, let's try to enjoy ourselves in the process, then.

spans.text: Well, let's try to enjoy ourselves in the process, then.

units.rawText: I certainly look forward to it.
units.displayText: I certainly look forward to it.

spans.text: I certainly look forward to it.

units.rawText: Python sits on a mechanical chair, and the data ports on his neck gleam with blue light.
units.displayText: Python sits on a mechanical chair, and the data ports on his neck gleam with blue light.

spans.text: Python sits on a mechanical chair, and the data ports on his neck gleam with blue light.

units.rawText: Relax, it's just a neural cloud examination and backup.
units.displayText: Relax, it's just a neural cloud examination and backup.

spans.text: Relax, it's just a neural cloud examination and backup.

units.rawText: ...It's just that I haven't looked back on memory data in a while. I'm not really in the habit of doing that.
units.displayText: ...It's just that I haven't looked back on memory data in a while. I'm not really in the habit of doing that.

spans.text: ...It's just that I haven't looked back on memory data in a while. I'm not really in the habit of doing that.

units.rawText: Then this might be a good opportunity for you. You'll be able to re-experience all the things that have happened to you since you were rolled out until you were uploaded to the cloud server and came to the Oasis.
units.displayText: Then this might be a good opportunity for you. You'll be able to re-experience all the things that have happened to you since you were rolled out until you were uploaded to the cloud server and came to the Oasis.

spans.text: Then this might be a good opportunity for you. You'll be able to re-experience all the things that have happened to you since you were rolled out until you were uploaded to the cloud server and came to the Oasis.

units.rawText: I'll be reliving my life, then?
units.displayText: I'll be reliving my life, then?

spans.text: I'll be reliving my life, then?

units.rawText: It probably won't take that long, it's more like a human having a dream⁠—or several dreams, as it were. In any case, don't worry too much.
units.displayText: It probably won't take that long, it's more like a human having a dream⁠—or several dreams, as it were. In any case, don't worry too much.

spans.text: It probably won't take that long, it's more like a human having a dream⁠—or several dreams, as it were. In any case, don't worry too much.

units.rawText: I'm not worried. You should relax a little too.
units.displayText: I'm not worried. You should relax a little too.

spans.text: I'm not worried. You should relax a little too.

units.rawText: Thanks.
units.displayText: Thanks.

spans.text: Thanks.

units.rawText: After reclining Python's mechanical chair, I press the key on the device.
units.displayText: After reclining Python's mechanical chair, I press the key on the device.

spans.text: After reclining Python's mechanical chair, I press the key on the device.

units.rawText: Preparation complete. Commencing evaluation process.
units.displayText: Preparation complete. Commencing evaluation process.

units.displayText: See you later, Commander.
